content: The American Diabetes Association emphasizes the importance of patient education and support in the effective management of diabetes. Patients must have a thorough understanding of how to monitor their blood glucose levels, adjust insulin doses appropriately, and use insulin safely to achieve optimal outcomes. It is critical for healthcare providers to work collaboratively to deliver comprehensive educational resources and address any concerns patients may have. This includes addressing barriers such as the financial burden of treatment and ensuring that insulin and related care are accessible to all patients.
